title: Benchtop slab-flattening router carriage
engineering: Unpowered crossbeam coupon with a 520 mm span and 0.023 mm peak modeled deflection under 20 N per rail.
physical_check: Use a dial indicator and individual deadweights to measure deflection and return-to-zero at three points across a supported coupon.

title: Large-ball desktop USB pointer
engineering: Large-ball pointer housing and forty deterministic selection-and-drag scripts. A deadband change filters stationary jitter in all traces.
physical_check: Have an intended user select ten targets per quadrant and perform button-held drags. Measure errors, ball force and cleanup access.

title: Book backing board pair
engineering: Matched 12° book backing boards with 290 mm working length and 9 mm exposed spine in the modeled press section.
physical_check: Fit opposite cheeks to a scrap book and compare formed shoulder location, cheek flex and finish transfer.

title: Spline-guided stitch groover
engineering: Two-point leather groove guide with 3 mm offset and less than 0.35 mm modeled curvature error on a 36 mm-radius coupon.
physical_check: Try an expendable blunt witness tip on straight and curved scrap. Compare measured offset before using the intended grooving insert.

title: Portafilter tamping cradle
engineering: Spouted portafilter cradle leaves 3 mm lateral and 8 mm vertical clearance in the modeled Gaggia Classic accessory envelope.
physical_check: Measure the actual accessory shoulder and spouts, then check level support through five orientations using an unheated portafilter.

title: Multiple-roll peel-edge label dispenser
engineering: Three separable roll lanes for 22, 34 and 41 mm liner widths. The common peel edge guides the liner through a 145° direction change.
physical_check: Load three actual rolls and verify label release, liner tracking and roll separation after repeated pulls.
